structural_change: k7 (H-SU 2026-10-16): k6 hbm_sfucore_split-k6-dea957e63 FLOORPLAN_MARGIN bank_distance (lanes 0/3/6/12.. 502 um from their E-face pins: only one lane column can sit within 100 um of one face) + TEXTBOOK REFUSE clk 18,143 sinks / rst_n 13,745 loads. Fix: ot_hgi_sfu_core_split2 splits the lane-direct buses W (lanes 0-7) / E (8-15) so each lane column hugs its own face; pin regs on their own roots clk_pw (W ~4.4k) / clk_pe (E ~2.7k), clk keeps bridge+engine (~10.9k); rst_n -> ot_rst_relay (4 regions). Floorplan: lane columns R0 W / MY E at 32.4 um from the faces, 352.08 pitch (21.6 um row gaps), 80 SRAMs abutted in the middle column (x 295.488), local_* W and io/ctl E moved above the lane field (2838.8..3560). Same outline 763.56 x 3580. | k9 (H-SU 10-17, coordinator 0co: k8 950.4x3132 3.3:1 off-lattice, CTS gate GPL stall): square-ish 1598.4 x 1771.2 (0.90:1) on the 43.2 um lattice. RTL ot_hgi_sfu_core_split3 = pure port re-slice of split2 into four lane face groups (lanes 0-3 W column R0, 4-7 N row, 8-11 E column MY, 12-15 S row; all lane origins on 43.2); 80 operand SRAMs (shared 16x16 crossbar store, not per lane) in 4 columns of 20 (x 388.8/604.8 MY, 820.8/1036.8 R0, y 475.2) with 43.2 channels; local_* + per-lane clocks W, io/ctl E; clk/rst_n/clk_lg central on N (x 799.2), clk_pw W mid / clk_pe E mid (regional pin-register roots). Recipe 4, OT_SFU_SYNC_RST. | k9pin (SFU-K9PIN 10-18, coordinator HANDOFF 0gj): io_word/compiler_control/fault (2,214 pins) moved from the E face to the N face, core-local x 1040.4-1576.8 (~4.1/um; with vi_*_n overlap 1040-1296 <= ~5/um), so the per-quadrant programme store sfup_<q> above the core's N corner links directly (store S-face io/ctl x 21.6-588.8). Pin rules unchanged (flop at each pin, clk_pe pin-register root). Pins only: RTL and floorplan unchanged. | k9face (HBM-KITS-C/SFUK9 10-18): the 10-18 06:04 --cts gate stalled (GPL 9,221 s, routability inflation +187%, 7.1% GCells overflowed; CTS/GRT killed at 14,400 s). Cause: ot_su12_sfu has all 2,186 connected pins on its W face (R0), so the W column (R0) and E column (MY) lanes faced the die edge: 8 x 2,186 lane nets left through the 43.2 um edge strips and had to cross the lane wall (M1-M6 blocked) through the 58 um row gaps (14,292 nets cross x=150 vs 4,427 at x=1447). Fix: lane pin faces turned to the core: W column MY (pins x 259.2 -> W band), E column R0 (pins x 1339.2 -> E band); row lanes 4/5/12/13 R0 (pins W) and 6/7/14/15 MY (pins E) so each corner gap carries one row lane + one column lane and the centre gap (above/below SRAM channel 777.6-820.8, 40 SRAM pin faces) carries none. Outline, macros, pins and RTL unchanged; route.io_hold_margin_ns 0.03 (>= 0.025). | k9dp (SFU-K9 10-18): the 06:04 gate textbook REFUSE logic_depth u_core.u_engine.u_memory.u_output.g_bank[8].u_b.ks[1] -> u_core.u_vm.g_lg[0].write_q[263] ~772 ps / 19 levels (operand-store output word select + sector rotate + BF16 round adder + write_q sector mux in one stage). Fix: split3 DRAIN_PIPE=1 -> ot_hgi_sfu_vm_static_bridge registers the whole drain interface once on clk (drain_v/round/vm_sector/result_v/data, ~550 flops) before the per-group round + write logic. Static schedule: drained sectors reach local_wq 1 edge later and local_w_done is expected 1 edge later (WRITE_RETURN unchanged, counted from the registered drain); the VM output region is not read inside the programme, so the compiler calendar is unchanged. Bench tb_hgi_sfu_split_equiv compares local_wq +1 edge (WQX=1) and returns write completions +1; new mutant nodrainpipe (data bypasses the stage) must fail. | k9ch (RH-K9PIN 10-19): the 10-18 18:18 --cts gate (5d57430bf) still stalled in routability GPL (7.43% GCells overflowed, +133,810 repair buffers; CTS/GRT GATE_STALL 14,400 s). Cause: the 80 operand SRAMs carry 821 M4 pins each on BOTH W and E faces (~10 pins/um); stacked flush in 4 columns with 43.2 um inner channels, each inner channel took 16.4k SRAM pins (~380 pins per um of channel width) vs ~130 in the two outer channels. Fix: the 4 columns re-spaced to five equal 77.76 um channels (x 336.96/587.52 MY, 838.08/1088.64 R0, on the 2.16 child lattice), inner channels +80%. Outline, lanes, pins, RTL unchanged. Reset landing (ROOT-RST 10-19 rule, recipe 4 default): every reset port lands in 2 registered stages on clk (all 39 entries are the same 770 ps synchronous clock, cross-root paths timed); reset release +2 cycles, a scheduled constant. | k9s (HBM-SAFE-K9 10-19, coordinator 0ks after SAFE-AUDIT-HBM: 2 failed --cts gates = structural redesign): (1) outline 1598.4x1771.2 -> 1771.2x1900.8 (W +172.8 approved; H +129.6 so each 16-bank group fits one column at 69.12 um pitch); (2) 80 SRAMs = 5 group columns (x 345.6/561.6/820.8/1036.8/1252.8 on the 43.2 lattice; col 0 = output group, 1-4 = operand groups 0-3), banks 0-15 bottom->top at 69.12 pitch: 411 M4 pins per 41.04 um face -> 5.95 pins/um (<= 6, M6 over-macro demand 11.9/um < 15.6 supply), 28.08 um gaps aligned across columns = full-width std-cell bands, channels 86.4/43.2/86.4/43.2/43.2/86.4; (3) lanes re-spread: W/E columns y 43.2/518.4/993.6/1468.8 (144.7 um gaps for the W/E face buses), N/S rows x 345.6/648/907.2/1209.6, N row y 1512; (4) per-group regional roots clk_st[4:0] (clk keeps bridge + engine control); (5) RTL WPIPE: bank-write landing stage (+1 edge, priced); (6) pin ranges rescaled (W/E 43.2-1857.6, N/S lanes 345.6-1425.6, io/ctl/fault N 1213.2-1749.6 = same 21.6 um from the NE corner; clocks N centre) | k9s3 (LH-K9R 10-19, SAFE-DESIGN items 1/3 after the k9s gate census: rst_n relay rr[0] 6,245 / rr[1] 1,059 and rst_lg_n__ot_rl1[k] 2,989 mapped loads each): split3 RST_TREE=1 -> every reset pin, after the kit's 2-stage face landing, feeds a registered two-level distribution tree (rtl/lib/ot_rst_kept_tree.sv) on its consumers' regional root: rst_n 16 -> 384 copies, rst_lg_n[k] 8 -> 160, rst_map_n[j] 1 -> 8, rst_lane_n[j] 1 -> 1; reset_relay_split (max 32, family u_fl_rst_*.ra|rb) re-points the loads over the kept copies after OT_RST_COPIES_SDFF folds the synchronous resets into $sdff SRST ports, so one coarse load = one mapped gate. Release port -> consumers 4 edges (was 5 for rst_n, 2 for lg/map/lane), scheduled constant. Outline, macros, pins, clocks unchanged from k9s2.
